_doc: Clip choice per enemy kind for tools/anim/animate.py. 'kind' names src/shared/Config/ProvingGrounds.json crowd.kinds; an attack slot's 'attack' is the index in that kind's attacks, and its windup is read from there at build time (never copied here). 'lead' is a clip stretched over the whole windup for clips that start at their release (throws, shots); 'contact' (seconds into the source clip) overrides the measured contact in ual_clips.json. 'gap' records where the Standard pack has no faithful clip and a stand-in is used.
